title: 3-Tier Corner Glass Shelf, 8-Inch x 8-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware (Foxtrot Collection) Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade unused corners with a 3-tier corner glass shelf that adds organized storage using thick tempered glass and solid brass hardware.

  • Designed to coordinate: Part of the foxtrot collection for matching foxtrot layouts with other designer bath accessories and textured bathroom hardware.
  • Strong glass shelves: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and strength.
  • Solid brass hardware: Crafted from solid brass materials for enduring support.
  • Clean install: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a finished look.
  • Complete kit: Includes the glass shelf and all installation hardware; no assembly required.

Specs

  • Dimensions: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
  • Glass thickness: 0.39 in
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement choices such as fire engine red, antique pewter, pink, venetian bronze, and lavender.

_previous.title: Foxtrot Collection Three Tier Corner Glass Shelf
_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary design 3-tier glass vanity corner shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelving unit is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
